$comment: Deterministic budgets, enforced in CI (tools/perf/check-budgets.mjs; requests by tests/e2e/kiosk-budget.spec.ts). CPU, memory and frame counts are report-only. The entry budgets are CI's (Linux) measured bytes; entryGzipSlack (0.1 %) is added on top because the same build gzips a few bytes apart per platform and runner image. Lower a budget when a change shrinks the number; raise one only with a reason in the commit.

packs.$comment: Per built-in pack (src/looks/packs/<id>.ts, its Look id): codeGzipBytes = its lazy JS and CSS chunks (found through the Vite manifest), gzip; assetBytes = the files in src/looks/packs/<id>/assets, bytes on disk; layersPerPage = max compositing layers per page with the pack on, over Classic (measured by the pack's own spec, not by check-budgets). Set to the measured size plus 25 %, never above packCeilingBytes (code gzip plus assets), lowered whenever a pack shrinks. A pack with no entry here fails the check (node tools/perf/check-budgets.mjs --packs). Layers are not measured (L69): the value is the plan's 24.
